v.n: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
v.s: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

v.n: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
v.s: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

v.n: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
v.s: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

v.p: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
v.n: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

v.n: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
v.s: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

v.n: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

v.n: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
v.s: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

v.n: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
v.s: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

v.n: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
v.s: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

v.n: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
v.s: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

v.n: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

v.n: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

v.n: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

v.n: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
v.s: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

v.n: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
v.s: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

v.n: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
v.s: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

v.n: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
v.s: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

v.n: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
v.s: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

v.n: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
v.s: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

v.n: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

v.n: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
v.s: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

v.n: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

v.n: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

v.n: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

v.n: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

v.n: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
v.s: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

v.n: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
v.s: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

v.n: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

v.n: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
v.s: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

v.n: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

v.n: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
v.s: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

v.n: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
v.s: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

v.n: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
v.s: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

v.n: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
v.s: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

v.n: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

v.n: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

v.n: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

v.n: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
v.s: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

v.n: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
v.s: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

v.n: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
v.s: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

v.n: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

v.n: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
v.s: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

v.n: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

v.n: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

v.n: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
v.s: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

v.n: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

v.n: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

v.n: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
v.s: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

v.n: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

v.n: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

v.n: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

v.n: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

v.n: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

v.n: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

v.n: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
v.s: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

v.n: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

v.n: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

v.n: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

v.n: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

v.n: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

v.n: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
v.s: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

v.n: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
v.s: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

v.n: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
v.s: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

v.n: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

v.n: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

v.p: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
v.n: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

v.n: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
v.s: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

v.n: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

v.n: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
v.s: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

v.n: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

v.n: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
v.s: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

v.n: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

v.n: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

v.n: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

v.n: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
v.s: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

v.n: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

v.n: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
v.s: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

v.n: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
v.s: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

v.n: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

v.n: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

v.n: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
v.s: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

v.n: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
v.s: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

v.n: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
v.s: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

v.n: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
v.s: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

v.n: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

v.n: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
v.s: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

v.n: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

v.n: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

v.p: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
v.n: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
v.s: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

v.n: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

v.n: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

v.n: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
v.s: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

v.n: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
v.s: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

v.n: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

v.n: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

v.n: Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

v.n: Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

v.n: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

v.p: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
v.n: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Heap Inspection Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) contain a heap inspection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

v.p: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
v.n: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

v.n: Metabase SQL Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

v.n: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

v.n: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
v.s: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

v.n: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
v.s: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

v.n: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
v.s: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

v.n: IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full remote code execution on default Langflow deployments.

v.n: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
v.s: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

v.n: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Use of Hard-coded Password Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) formerly known as Firepower Management Center contains a use of hard-coded password vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in to an affected device using a low-privileged account to access sensitive data within the impacted systems.

v.n: Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiOS contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability. This may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass the patch developed for the symbolic link persistency mechanism observed in some post-exploit cases, via crafted HTTP requests. An attacker would need first to have compromised the product via another vulnerability, at filesystem level.

v.n: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem OS Command Injection Vulnerability

v.s: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller, formerly SD-WAN vSmart, and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, formerly SD-WAN vManage, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system. This vulnerability exists because the peering authentication mechanism in an affected system is not working properly. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted requests to an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to log in to an affected Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller as an internal, high-privileged, non-root user account. Using this account, the attacker could access NETCONF, which would then allow the attacker to manipulate network configuration for the SD-WAN fabric.

v.n: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability when an user logs-in to the affected product and sends a specially crafted HTTP request.

v.n: RoundCube Webmail Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
v.s: RoundCube Webmail contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote code execution by authenticated users because the _from parameter in a URL is not validated in program/actions/settings/upload.php.

v.n: RoundCube Webmail Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
v.s: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.

v.n: GitLab Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
v.s: GitLab contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability when requests to the internal network for webhooks are enabled.

v.n: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
v.s: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) contains an use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the underlying operating system and root-level persistence.

v.n: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
v.s: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability if WebEx zimlet installed and zimlet JSP is enabled.

v.n: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
v.s: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware does not properly validate the content of uploaded files. Remote attackers with administrator privileges on the product platform can upload malicious files, which can be used to execute arbitrary system commands on the server.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control contains a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted Web page. When a user views the Web page, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the logged-on user.

v.n: Google Chromium CSS Use-After-Free Vulnerability
v.s: Google Chromium CSS contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

v.p: Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)
v.n: BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)contain an OS command injection vulnerability. Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute operating system commands in the context of the site user. Successful exploitation requires no authentication or user interaction and may lead to system compromise, including unauthorized access, data exfiltration, and service disruption.

v.n: Apple Multiple Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow an attacker with memory write the capability to execute arbitrary code.

v.n: Microsoft Configuration Manager SQL Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Configuration Manager contains an SQL injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted requests to the target environment which are processed in an unsafe manner enabling the attacker to execute commands on the server and/or underlying database.

v.n: Notepad++ Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
v.s: Notepad++ when using the WinGUp updater, contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability that could allow an attacker to intercept or redirect update traffic to download and execute an attacker-controlled installer. This could lead to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the user.

v.n: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Security Control Bypass Vulnerability
v.s: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a security control bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to certain restricted functionality.

v.n: Microsoft MSHTML Framework Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft MSHTML Framework contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

v.n: Microsoft Windows NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Remote Access Connection Manager contains a NULL pointer dereference that could allow an unauthorized attacker to deny service locally.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Shell Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Remote Desktop Services contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Type Confusion Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Desktop Windows Manager contains a type confusion vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

v.n: Microsoft Office Word Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Office Word contains a reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

v.n: React Native Community CLI OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: React Native Community CLI contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated network attackers to send POST requests to the Metro Development Server and run arbitrary executables via a vulnerable endpoint exposed by the server. On Windows, attackers can also execute arbitrary shell commands with fully controlled arguments.

v.n: SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
v.s: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in the ConnectToHub API method. This could allow the attacker to point the SmarterMail instance to a malicious HTTP server which serves the malicious OS command and could lead to command execution.

v.n: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
v.s: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability which could allow unauthorized external users to perform Server Side Requests via the CI Lint API.

v.n: Sangoma FreePBX OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Sangoma FreePBX Endpoint Manager contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow for a post-authentication command injection by an authenticated known user via the testconnection -> check_ssh_connect() function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to potentially obtain remote access to the system as an asterisk user.

v.n: Sangoma FreePBX Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: Sangoma FreePBX contains an improper authentication vulnerability that potentially allows unauthorized users to bypass password authentication and access services provided by the FreePBX admin.

v.n: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
v.s: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution, which would allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine. This could be exploited without authentication.

v.n: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

v.n: Fortinet Multiple Products Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, FortiOS, and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an attacker with a FortiCloud account and a registered device to log into other devices registered to other accounts, if FortiCloud SSO authentication is enabled on those devices.

v.n: Linux Kernel Integer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: Linux Kernel contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the create_elf_tables() function which could allow an unprivileged local user with access to SUID (or otherwise privileged) binary to escalate their privileges on the system.

v.n: SmarterTools SmarterMail Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
v.s: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to any location on the mail server, potentially enabling remote code execution.

v.n: SmarterTools SmarterMail Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
v.s: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the password reset API. The force-reset-password endpoint permits anonymous requests and fails to verify the existing password or a reset token when resetting system administrator accounts. This could allow an unauthenticated attacker to supply a target administrator username and a new password to reset the account, resulting in full administrative compromise of the SmarterMail instance.

v.n: GNU InetUtils Argument Injection Vulnerability
v.s: GNU InetUtils contains an argument injection vulnerability in telnetd that could allow for remote authentication bypass via a "-f root" value for the USER environment variable.

v.n: Microsoft Office Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Office contains a security feature bypass vulnerability in which reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision in Microsoft Office could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally. Some of the impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

v.n: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

v.n: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) PHP Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
v.s: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a PHP remote file inclusion vulnerability that could allow for remote attackers to craft requests to the /h/rest endpoint to influence internal request dispatching, allowing inclusion of arbitrary files from the WebRoot directory.

v.n: Versa Concerto Improper Authentication Vulnerability
v.s: Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

v.n: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
v.s: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.

v.n: Prettier eslint-config-prettier Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
v.s: Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

v.n: Cisco Unified Communications Products Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM), Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME), Cisco Unified Communications Manager IM & Presence Service (Unified CM IM&P), Cisco Unity Connection, and Cisco Webex Calling Dedicated Instance contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow the attacker to obtain user-level access to the underlying operating system and then elevate privileges to root.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Information Disclosure Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Desktop Windows Manager contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to disclose information locally.

v.n: Gogs Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: Gogs contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting improper Symbolic link handling in the PutContents API that could allow for code execution.

v.n: Microsoft Office PowerPoint Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Office PowerPoint contains a code injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a PowerPoint file with an OutlineTextRefAtom containing an invalid index value that triggers memory corruption.

v.n: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

v.n: MongoDB and MongoDB Server Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency Vulnerability
v.s: MongoDB Server contains an improper handling of length parameter inconsistency vulnerability in Zlib compressed protocol headers. This vulnerability may allow a read of uninitialized heap memory by an unauthenticated client.

v.n: Digiever DS-2105 Pro Missing Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: Digiever DS-2105 Pro contains a missing authorization vulnerability which could allow for command injection via time_tzsetup.cgi.

v.n: WatchGuard Firebox Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: WatchGuard Fireware OS iked process contains an out of bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process. This vulnerability may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code and affects both the mobile user VPN with IKEv2 and the branch office VPN using IKEv2 when configured with a dynamic gateway peer.

v.n: ASUS Live Update Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
v.s: ASUS Live Update contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability client were distributed with unauthorized modifications introduced through a supply chain compromise. The modified builds could cause devices meeting specific targeting conditions to perform unintended actions. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

v.n: SonicWall SMA1000 Missing Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: SonicWall SMA1000 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation appliance management console (AMC) of affected devices.

v.n: Cisco Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
v.s: Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Secure Email, AsyncOS Software, and Web Manager appliances contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows threat actors to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system of an affected appliance.

v.n: Fortinet Multiple Products Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchMaster, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass the FortiCloud SSO login authentication via a crafted SAML message. Please be aware that CVE-2025-59719 pertains to the same problem and is mentioned in the same vendor advisory. Ensure to apply all patches mentioned in the advisory.

v.n: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Hard Coded Cryptographic Vulnerability
v.s: Gladinet CentreStack and TrioFox contain a hardcoded cryptographic keys vulnerability for their implementation of the AES cryptoscheme. This vulnerability degrades security for public exposed endpoints that may make use of it and may offer arbitrary local file inclusion when provided a specially crafted request without authentication.

v.n: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free WebKit Vulnerability
v.s: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a use-after-free vulnerability in WebKit. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

v.n: Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
v.s: Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. A specially crafted HTTP request can upload a file, resulting in executable code being uploaded, and routable, to the webserver. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

v.n: Google Chromium Out of Bounds Memory Access Vulnerability
v.s: Google Chromium contains an out of bounds memory access vulnerability in ANGLE that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

v.n: OSGeo GeoServer Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
v.s: OSGeo GeoServer contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that occurs when the application accepts XML input through a specific endpoint /geoserver/wms operation GetMap and could allow an attacker to define external entities within the XML request.

v.n: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Use After Free Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver contains a use after free vulnerability that can allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

v.n: D-Link Routers Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
v.s: D-Link Routers contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

v.n: Array Networks ArrayOS AG OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Array Networks ArrayOS AG contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

v.n: Meta React Server Components Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
v.s: Meta React Server Components contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting a flaw in how React decodes payloads sent to React Server Function endpoints. Please note CVE-2025-66478 has been rejected, but it is associated with CVE-2025- 55182.

v.n: OpenPLC ScadaBR Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
v.s: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

v.n: Android Framework Information Disclosure Vulnerability
v.s: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

v.n: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
v.s: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

v.n: OpenPLC ScadaBR Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
v.s: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via system_settings.shtm.

v.n: Oracle Fusion Middleware Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
v.s: Oracle Fusion Middleware contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to take over Identity Manager.

v.n: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
v.s: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows for heap corruption.

v.n: Fortinet FortiWeb OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiWeb contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code on the underlying system via crafted HTTP requests or CLI commands.

v.n: Fortinet FortiWeb Path Traversal Vulnerability
v.s: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute administrative commands on the system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

v.n: Gladinet Triofox Improper Access Control Vulnerability
v.s: Gladinet Triofox contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows access to initial setup pages even after setup is complete.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Race Condition Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability that allows a local attacker with low-level privileges to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could enable the attacker to gain SYSTEM-level access.

v.n: WatchGuard Firebox Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: WatchGuard Firebox contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

v.n: Samsung Mobile Devices Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
v.s: Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so. This vulnerability could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

v.n: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
v.s: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known.

v.n: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
v.s: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

v.p: VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools
v.n: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools Privilege Defined with Unsafe Actions Vulnerability
v.s: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a privilege defined with unsafe actions vulnerability. A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.

v.n: XWiki Platform Eval Injection Vulnerability
v.s: XWiki Platform contains an eval injection vulnerability that could allow any guest to perform arbitrary remote code execution through a request to SolrSearch.

v.n: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Code Injection Vulnerability
v.s: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

v.n: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Missing Authorization Vulnerability
v.s: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileged access to the application.

v.n: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
v.s: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API.

v.n: Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
v.s: Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.
